subject: english
prompt: Which sign tells people that only workers may enter?

answer.explanation: STAFF ONLY limits entry to staff members, so it communicates a restricted area.

solutionStrategy: 找出身分限制詞 only，再判斷誰能進入。
solutionSteps: Read each sign as a short instruction or label.
Identify STAFF as a group of workers.
Explain why welcome or sit does not control entry.
